lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 to 12 distinct, high-contrast vertical white line segments are visible across the torso mass; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight increase in density toward the posterior third of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three posterior-most vertical lines exhibit fragmentation, appearing as series of dashed segments or circular points rather than continuous dorsal-ventral lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of approximately 5-6 distinct white spots is visible on the lower posterior flank and the upper transition of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spots on the lower mid-flank forms a semi-connected geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast white spots are present on the lower cheek/mandible region; a wide white horizontal patch is visible across the lower throat; white bands are visible on the interior upper surfaces of the forelimbs.
